description: Defines the HTMLPurifier_Token_Comment class, representing comment tokens within the HTMLPurifier library. This class is used to encapsulate comment data in the token stream during HTML purification.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_Comment
classes.description: Represents a comment token in the HTMLPurifier token stream, containing comment data and metadata such as line and column info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an instance of HTMLPurifier_Token_Comment with comment data, and optionally line and column numbers.
